units.source_text: > 父亲由于母亲的死，也不再坚持他的意见，同意我们结婚了。

en.t: Because of my mother's death, my father no longer insisted on his own opinion and agreed to let us marry.

units.source_text: 可能就是为了这个吧，他给我准备了一套黑色的丧服。

en.t: Perhaps for that very reason, he prepared a set of black mourning clothes for me.

units.source_text: 现在，我打扮得悲悲切切的。

en.t: Now I am dressed in a sorrowful, mournful way.

units.source_text: 我是和你同居以后第一次穿上礼服，脸虽有点憔悴，却实在很美。

en.t: This is the first time I have worn formal dress since I began living with you; though my face is a little worn, I am truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 我多么想让你看见镜中的我啊。

en.t: How I wish you could see me in the mirror.
That is why I am taking a moment to write to you.

units.source_text: 但是为了我们，我将要求穿着华丽的结婚礼服。

en.t: But for our sake, I will ask to wear a splendid wedding dress.

units.source_text: 我是很想早点回去的，可是觉得过去那样从家里出走，现在该是向家人表示歉意的好机会，就在这里坚持到母亲的五七。

en.t: I very much want to go back soon, but I feel that, after having run away from home like that, this is a good chance to show my family my regret, so I will stay here until my mother's fifth seven-day memorial.

units.source_text: 再说，绫子来了，你身边的事可以托付她来料理。

en.t: Besides, Ayako has come, so the things around you can be entrusted to her care.

units.source_text: 弟弟向着我，他小小年纪，在亲戚面前总是袒护我，实在可爱。

en.t: My younger brother is on my side; though he is still so young, he always defends me in front of the relatives, and he is truly dear.

units.source_text: 这张梳妆台，我也准备带回去。

en.t: I am also planning to take this dressing table back with me.
